summary: Frontend-only verification of 13 recent changes on CEECO HDPE static React SPA. All 13 requested items PASS. Console errors: 0 across all 6 routes. Overflow audit: all pages pass at 375px; at 320px (Galaxy Fold edge case) Home shows 4px overflow (322px hero background image) and Contact shows 11px overflow (decorative bottom-right accent-line span with absolute right:0 w-16). Actual headings do not overflow at either breakpoint - overflow is caused by decorative absolutely-positioned accent-line spans/background image, not typography. Reporting as minor design observations, not blockers.

issues: 4px horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=324, clientWidth=320). Culprit: hero background renders at 322px (left:-1, right:321). Not a heading issue; decorative image scale.

11px horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=331, clientWidth=320). Culprit: decorative underline SPAN with 'accent-line' class, absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-16 h-[3px] bg-brand-green - width 64px starts at right:267 extending to 331. Would fix by clipping (overflow-x:hidden on parent or reducing accent-line width at <=320px).

action_items: Optional: address 320px decorative overflow - either add overflow-x:hidden to body/main or constrain the Contact H2 accent-line span (w-16 -> w-12 at scale at <=320px. Non-blocking since 375px+ (all mainstream mobile) is clean.

Hash-based smooth scroll to #enquiry-form works both on same-page (Contact anchors) and cross-route navigation (Products/Home -> Contact).
Sheet built-in X successfully hidden via Tailwind arbitrary variant [&>button]:hidden; single custom close remains and functions.
